name: Judy Justice
description: The Honorable Judy Sheindlin, retired Judge of the Manhattan family Court, brings her signature blend of sharp wit and wisdom, hilarious candor and unwavering honesty that has made her America’s favorite judge for over 25 years, as she presides over real cases, arbitrates binding decisions and delivers what only she can: “Judy Justice.”

videos.title: Girlfriend Demands Payback
videos.overview: Both sides sue for the $10K court maximum when a woman suffers a heart attack after being hit in the face during a road rage incident. She is accused of spitting on and "potentially spreading COVID" to the young woman who attacked her.

videos.title: Road Rage Heart Attack
videos.overview: Both sides sue for the $10K court maximum when a woman suffers a heart attack after being hit in the face during a road rage incident. She is accused of spitting on and "potentially spreading COVID" to the young woman who attacked her.

videos.title: Fighting while Driving
videos.overview: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, when a woman bails her sister's car out of impound, she expects gratitude and repayment instead of alleged child endangerment and payback refusal. In the second case, a woman accuses her cousin of disguising himself with a wig, make-up and mask in order to use her Lyft account to earn money as a driver.

videos.title: Sister Feud/Driver in Disguise
videos.overview: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, when a woman bails her sister's car out of impound, she expects gratitude and repayment instead of alleged child endangerment and payback refusal. In the second case, a woman accuses her cousin of disguising himself with a wig, make-up and mask in order to use her Lyft account to earn money as a driver.

videos.title: Backyard Fist Fight
videos.overview: A man's attempt to retrieve his recording equipment escalates into a fight. A father sues for alleged emotional trauma suffered by his fiancée and four-year-old son.

videos.title: Co-Signing Exes/ Suspected Check Fraud
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. First, a woman goes after her ex-lover for the $10K court max accusing him of theft, larceny and emotional distress. In the next case, a friendship of 30 years ends when a man volunteers to cash a check for a friend. She insists it was payment for months of online survey work and that they were both part of a fraudulent check scam.

videos.title: Star Athlete's Tragic Accident
videos.overview: A college basketball star totals an ex-girlfriend's vehicle in an accident that leaves him comatose. After recovering, he is sued for totaling her car and for alleged theft.

videos.title: Child's Stimulus Check Tug-of-War; Cleaning-Business Payback
videos.overview: In this episode, Her Honor rules on two cases. In the first, a teacher sues her daughter's ex for tax fraud when he cashes a stimulus check for his child; she claims it was legally hers. Next up for the Judge, a business owner loans money to an employee so she can purchase a car to get to work. The employee says she was asked to pick up other workers daily, one of whom she claims caused a wreck.

videos.title: Tween Braces
videos.overview: Unwed parents fight over braces and travel expenses for their 11-year-old daughter. The father is accused of making nasty comments about the young girl's teeth.

videos.title: Flipping and Fighting; Amusement Park Drama
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. First up, former classmates reunite after 35 years and begin to date and flip houses together. A profit dispute leaves them fighting over a personal loan. In the next proceeding, a woman regrets taking a family trip to Disney World with her ex-boyfriend's new fiancé. She sues the fiancé for expenses and is uninvited to their wedding.

videos.title: Tween's Controversial Phone Use
videos.overview: Divorcees fight over their 10-year-old son's phone when adult videos, GPS tracking and alleged content loss come into play.

videos.title: Newlywed's Make-Up Artist
videos.overview: A make-up artist is blasted on social media by a disgruntled newlywed; both parties accuse each other of breaching a wedding contract for cosmetic services.

videos.title: Father and Son Payback
videos.overview: A man cites his mother's death and jailtime for back child-support as obstacles preventing him from paying his father back for a loan.

videos.title: Teen Beach House Birthday Fail
videos.overview: A teenager's 17th birthday party is cut short when she and her friends are kicked out of their beach house rental. The owner claims the girl's mother ignored strict regulations regarding unaccompanied minors.

videos.title: Mother/Daughter Cosmetic Surgery
videos.overview: A young mother of four claims her $7,000 tummy tuck was a gift from a parent and was never designed to be a loan. Her unemployed mother, who charged the surgery on her credit card, tells a different story.

videos.title: Gold Pocket-Watch Mystery
videos.overview: A $14k gold pocket watch is allegedly stolen by an online buyer who accuses an established Ebay salesman of sending him the wrong piece of jewelry.

videos.title: Mother Caught in the Middle
videos.overview: When a man's marriage is in trouble, his mother comes to the rescue and helps with legal fees. When he reunites with his wife, the mother wants her money back as well as visitation with her grandson.

videos.title: Co-Parenting Nightmare
videos.overview: A man claims the mother of his child came after him with a knife during a heated fight; she spends two nights in jail and demands payback for damages suffered due to his allegedly false charges.

videos.title: Ex-Lover Payback
videos.overview: A woman sues her ex-boyfriend and his new wife for thousands in alleged loans. She claims fraudulent credit card use and demands the return of property.

videos.title: Neighbor Nightmare
videos.overview: (Part 1) A dispute over pet clean-up escalates into a fight between feuding neighbors. A man sues for $10,000 in damages for assault, threats and attorney fees.

videos.title: Neighbor Nightmare
videos.overview: (Part 2) A dispute over pet clean-up escalates into a fight between feuding neighbors. A man sues for $10,000 in damages for assault, threats and attorney fees.

videos.title: COVID and College Coeds/Car Vandalism and Jealousy
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. In the first, a college student says illegal drug use and the risk of COVID forced her to move out of an apartment early. She is sued by her roommate's father for allegedly breaking the lease. In the next proceeding, a woman is accused of vandalizing a vehicle with her bare hands in a fit of rage, which she denies.

videos.title: Wrought-Iron Rage
videos.overview: A welder is accused of damaging a decorative, iron gate when his client did not come up with the agreed-upon cash payment for his services.

videos.title: Pit Bull Attack
videos.overview: A pit-bull owner denies liability when a 14-year-old miniature pinscher is mauled on his property. He claims the smaller dog jumped his gate and started the fight.

videos.title: Family In Crisis
videos.overview: (Part 1) Repeated fist-a-cuffs, vandalism and police intervention leave the Judge with no other choice than to advise a family to set boundaries with restraining orders.

videos.title: Family In Crisis
videos.overview: (Part 2) Repeated fist-a-cuffs, vandalism and police intervention leave the Judge with no other choice than to advise a family to set boundaries with restraining orders.

videos.title: Car Title Takeover/Vegas Drinking Binge
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a man demands that his ex-girlfriend sign a car title over to him but admits he has no driver's license or insurance. The Judge explains the concept of coming to court with 'dirty hands.' In the next proceeding, when a woman passes out in a Las Vegas airport, her travel partner says she misses a flight in order to take care of her.

videos.title: Assault with a Deadly Hedge Clipper?
videos.overview: A mechanic accuses a smog station manager of attempted assault, alleged vandalism and failure to pay for his work.

videos.title: Missing Trailer Mystery
videos.overview: A man leaves his friend's trailer in a neighbor's driveway. When it goes missing, his friend sues him for the cost of the stolen trailer.

videos.title: Trail Ride Disaster
videos.overview: A state park in North Dakota is the setting for a family-friendly trail ride that ends in chaos. An off-leash dog attacks the lead horse, riders are thrown to the ground, and a pony is severely injured.

videos.title: COVID Wedding Upset
videos.overview: A wedding is canceled due to the pandemic leaving a newlywed and her wedding planner in a fight over their business contract.

videos.title: Storage Container Wars
videos.overview: A storage container buyer demands $10K when six containers allegedly block his access to 'valuable' property.

videos.title: Dog Breeding Side Hustle
videos.overview: A miniature Dachshund makes an appearance in court when amateur dog breeders fight over stud fees and pet custody.

videos.title: Spiritual Health Coach Dispute/20K Business Loan Debate
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. First, a life coach is sued for defamation of character after allegedly posting 'before' pictures of a former client; they dispute the terms and payment of their contract. In the second case, a woman sues her daughter for unpaid school expenses after discovering she received a sizeable loan from the government.

videos.title: Birthday Influencer or Personal Loan/Deer in the Headlights
videos.overview: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. The first case features a helicopter reporter who denies owing $6K to a friend for his birthday party; he claims she organized the event to enhance her own social media status. Next up, a man helps his ex pay for repairs after she crashes into a deer and also says he loaned her money for her daughter's school expenses.

videos.title: Unfit Wedding Ring
videos.overview: After paying $3K for the diamond ring of her dreams, a bride-to-be discovers that the band does not fit. The online ring-seller claims he received the jewelry as collateral for posting bail for a family member.

videos.title: Family, Furniture and the Fallout
videos.overview: A mother claims to be entitled to her son's stimulus check after alleging that she was supporting him; he says he was living with his girlfriend at the time.

videos.title: Single Mother Struggle
videos.overview: A single mother facing homelessness says her car was illegally repossessed. Allegations of welfare fraud and calls to CPS come into play.

videos.title: Caregiver Boyfriend; Shih Tzu Custody Battle
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, a man volunteers to care for his new girlfriend after tummy tuck surgery and then loans her money for rent. His goodwill ends after he alleges that he was hustled into supplying food for her football party. In the next proceeding, a Shih Tzu makes an appearance in court when co-workers fight over a litter of puppies and vet bill costs.

videos.title: Body Reshaping Gone Bad
videos.overview: A woman claims she did not expect body-sculpting injections into her buttocks; she sues for allegedly false advertising and for emotional distress.

videos.title: Attorney/Mechanic Face-Off
videos.overview: The $10K court max is at stake when a small-town attorney goes up against a small-town mechanic. They dispute liability after a vehicle allegedly implodes during a family road trip.

videos.title: Hollywood Collectibles Controversy
videos.overview: An estate sale featuring Hollywood collectibles is at the center of a dispute between fans of niche genre films. A buyer is accused of reneging on a verbal contract to purchase valuable posters which could have been sold to other interested parties.

videos.title: COVID Infection Controversy; Music Video Fail
videos.overview: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. First up, a couple sues for punitive damages after claiming their former roommate, who had COVID, infected them. In the next case, a musical team demand the court's maximum judgment against a videographer for the alleged non-delivery of a music video; the videographer countersues for $10K for defamation of character when clients post complaints online.

videos.title: Horse Care Barter Battle
videos.overview: Two women fight over the use of a trailer in exchange for the care of nine horses. This agreement ends with claims of a false arrest and illegal eviction.

videos.title: Teen Drives Truck Into Tree; Hair Extension/ Defamation Fight
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge presides over two cases. First up, parents fight over liability when unlicensed teens get behind the wheel of a truck and have an accident. Next, a salon owner goes after a former client for payment of hair extensions; she is met with a countersuit for alleged online defamation.

videos.title: Bride's Cable Car Calamity; Apartment Up in Flames
videos.overview: In this episode, Her Honor rules on two cases. In the first, a six-figure San Francisco wedding comes to an abrupt halt when a cable car rented to transport the bridal party to the church breaks down. The newlywed bride and her father sue for damages. In the second proceeding, a flight attendant's apartment is deemed uninhabitable after her boyfriend allegedly causes a fire while she is at work.

videos.title: Good Samaritan Teen Rip-Off
videos.overview: A young man is accused of deceiving a minor when he uses a social media app to request money from his neighbors.

videos.title: Beauty Salon Brawl
videos.overview: A woman sues for the $10K court maximum for damages due to an alleged assault at a beauty salon; she is accused of starting the fight and is countersued for $10K.

videos.title: Unwanted Dog Pregnancy; Divorced Parents' Dispute
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, a woman refuses to leave a man's home without her puppy pick-of-the-litter. He claims he never wanted to breed his pet with her mixed breed dog. In the next case, divorced parents fight over an alleged assault, stimulus money and restraining orders.

videos.title: Lipo-Surgery Sister Care
videos.overview: A nurse demands payment from her sister for care she provided after her sister's liposuction surgery.

videos.title: Fine Lines and Fire Arms
videos.overview: Citing a rise in Asian hate crimes, a man attempts to purchase a personal firearm; he sues for a full refund after his application is rejected.

videos.title: Error Code Car Alert; Feuding Cousins
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, a young woman's interpretation of a 30-day warranty is called into question when she sends her used car salesman a 'repair' bill that approaches the value of the car. In the 2nd case, a single mother loses her job shortly after moving in to her cousin's basement. She is sued for rent, loans, babysitting and property damage.

videos.title: Teen Drivers and Collisions and Guns...Oh My!
videos.overview: A young woman is accused of running a red light and totaling another teenager's vehicle; police apprehend a passenger who flees the scene of the crime with a gun.

videos.title: When Roosters Attack
videos.overview: A professional housekeeper sues a former employer for $7K in damages due to multiple alleged attacks by an aggressive pet rooster.

videos.title: For Love or Money
videos.overview: After purchasing a motorcycle with his fiancée, a man suffers a terrible accident on the vehicle; he says he regrets the purchase and ends up fighting with her over its cost.

videos.title: Hijacked Packages; Fighting and Forgiving
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, suing for the 10K court max, a man accuses his neighbor of stealing packages from his front door and burglarizing his apartment; he claims to have video of the alleged theft. In the second case, a volatile relationship ends in a fight over clothing that was shredded allegedly during a jealous rage and damages to a vehicle.

videos.title: Drinking Problem
videos.overview: A man claims his landlord's behavior caused him to have a drinking problem; she sues him for damaging his property while intoxicated.

videos.title: Playing-Card Club Controversy
videos.overview: The founder of a popular social club in Florida is accused of mishandling funds from his own card-playing group; he sues for defamation of character and for attorney fees.

videos.title: Neighborhood Dog Attack; Cancun Vacation Drama
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First up, neighbors dispute liability when a mini Schnauzer is allegedly attacked by a large Cane Corso. The risk of owning potentially vicious dog breeds comes into play. In the next case, ex-lovers fight over the cost of a failed trip to Cancun after their relationship falls apart.

videos.title: Hookah Headache
videos.overview: Both parties sue for the $10,000 court max in a fight over a hookah lounge that allegedly caused intense, physical stress to its upstairs neighbor. The lounge owner claims the neighbor harassed customers and repeatedly called the police.

videos.title: Fight Night and Sideswipes
videos.overview: A tense living situation escalates into a hit-and-run caught on tape; the parties are accused of drug use and assault.

videos.title: Remodeling & Eviction Nightmare
videos.overview: A woman accuses her landlord of wrongfully evicting her and her 17 cats from a 40-acre property. He is also accused by another tenant of reneging on an agreement to pay for remodeling work.

videos.title: Car-Slam Into Cyclist
videos.overview: A young cyclist collides with a vehicle on his way to work and sues for $7,500 in damages; the motorist disputes that the cyclist had the right of way.

videos.title: Wedding Planner Drama
videos.overview: A professional planner must prove she worked on a wedding for her friend's daughter; she claims she was fired on rehearsal day.

videos.title: Retaliatory Vandalism
videos.overview: A woman sues for the 10K court maximum for damages due to an alleged assault at a beauty salon; she is accused of starting the fight and is countersued for 10K.

videos.title: Retaliatory Vandalism: Part 2/Playing House Together
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first is Part 2 of the previous episode in which a man accuses a woman of driving his truck and totaling it; she countersues for 10K claiming he retaliated by burglarizing her home and terrorizing her children. In the next case, a couple seeks a legal remedy to a fight over shared property and defamation claims.

videos.title: Daycare Dilemma
videos.overview: A daycare owner accuses a mother of falsely disputing childcare fees; the mother claims the daycare owner altered electronic media to prove her case.

videos.title: Bed Breakup; Music Video Dispute
videos.overview: In this episode, Her Honor rules on two cases. First up, a man accuses his ex-girlfriend of disposing of his belongings; he also claims to be the rightful owner of a bed they allegedly bought while together. In the second case, a director is accused of stealing a client's music video ideas to use on a project with another client.

videos.title: Teens Accused of Collision
videos.overview: A loud, crashing sound alerts a woman to the fact that her parked car has been totaled by allegedly intoxicated teenagers; a video of the aftermath is introduced as evidence.

videos.title: Death of a Puppy
videos.overview: A woman claims a dog-breeder subletter caused her American Bully's death by exposing the animal to his dog who had parvo; she sues for thousands in vet bills.

videos.title: Motorcycle Mishap; Fire Lane Fiasco
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a young man sues his landlord for 5K in damages after his motorcycle is hit by a truck; he also accuses the landlord of wrongfully evicting him. Next up, while chasing an unleashed puppy, a man slips and falls into a woman's car causing damage to the vehicle; he claims he owes nothing because she was parked illegally.

videos.title: Bourbon Street Break-Up
videos.overview: After a long road-trip from Texas, a public argument leads to ex-lovers stranding each other in New Orleans; they fight over missing belongings and the cost to get home.

videos.title: Magnet Madness; Wellness Center Controversy
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a large advertisement magnet flies off of a truck and hits another vehicle on the highway; a business owner and a married couple fight over the cost to repair damages. In the second case, an entrepreneur starting a wellness center claims her business was stalled by delayed documentation services.

videos.title: Friends With Benefits Fail
videos.overview: After becoming intimately involved with a friend, a woman is accused of making false allegations of gun violence in order to have him removed from his home. (Part 1)

videos.title: Friends With Benefits Fail
videos.overview: After becoming intimately involved with a friend, a woman is accused of making false allegations of gun violence in order to have him removed from his home. (Part 2)

videos.title: Sick Kitties
videos.overview: Suing for the 10K court max, a woman claims a cat breeder is responsible for she and her cats getting ring worm and being sick.

videos.title: Recreational Disaster; Coin Collection Collateral
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. In the first case, a businessman sues for the $10K court max claiming he lost rental revenue due to a customer damaging his jet skis. In the second case, a woman admits to holding a man's coin collection ransom until he signs over a car title; the Judge has another plan in store for her.

videos.title: Nasty Breakup; Flipping Twins
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, ex-lovers accuse each other of vandalism, harassment and stalking. In the next case, identical twin brothers get into a heated fight over alleged profits made from flipping a house.

videos.title: Sisters Roommate Nightmare
videos.overview: A personal crisis inspires sisters to move in together, only to be torn apart by allegations of domestic abuse and a restraining order. They sue each other for thousands in property damage, a constructive eviction and harassment.

videos.title: Chihuahua vs. Pit Bull
videos.overview: A family's beloved family pet is euthanized after a tragic encounter with a neighbor's pit bull.

videos.title: The Missing Engagement Ring; Car Accident Payback
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, after a five-month relationship, a man sues his ex-fiancée for the court max of 10K for the cost of a diamond engagement ring; she says she got drunk and likely lost it in a lake. In the second, after a woman suffers injuries in a car accident, she discovers her vehicle was not paid off; she sues the man who sold it to her.

videos.title: Dog Show Drama
videos.overview: A dispute between a dog-show veteran and a young, canine trainer allegedly turns violent. They fight over dog-show costs, boarding fees and the assault in question.

videos.title: California Wildfire Payout and Quinceanera and COVID
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. In the first case, unwed parents, who were victims of the fire in Paradise, California, fight over property damage, an alleged assault and wrongful 'eviction'. In the second, parents hire a photographer for their daughter's Quinceanera which is cancelled due to COVID; they sue for photography costs.

videos.title: Motor Bike Blues
videos.overview: A woman purchases a customized motor-bike for her daughter's 15th birthday; she sues for a refund and damages to her home.

videos.title: Ghosted Tickets; Staged Furniture Fail
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a young woman claims she was ghosted by an online seller after shelling out $1500 for VIP tickets to a musical festival. In the second case, a man's attempt to sell furniture used to stage his property hits a snag when the Judge takes a closer look at contract terms.

videos.title: Dog Breeding Battle
videos.overview: A veteran dog-breeder takes issue with a novice attempting to breed papered dogs while having a mutt in the same living space.

videos.title: Buyer Beware
videos.overview: A business owner sues a musician for over 7K demanding a refund on a 'tour' bus he claims was sold under false pretenses.

videos.title: Ski Snafu
videos.overview: While on vacation, a man rents jet skis for his grandchildren and is accused of damaging them to the tune of over $4,000.

videos.title: Doggy Door War; Charity Motorcycle Riders
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a teenager tries to crawl through a doggy door to retrieve her pit bull who was attacking a neighbor's chihuahua. The owner of the injured chihuahua sues for vet bills and pain and suffering. Next up, the founder/president of a charity accuses his organization's treasurer of embezzling funds that were intended for those in need.

videos.title: Relationship Vacation Fail
videos.overview: After meeting online, ex-lovers fight over a vacation package they purchased together that lasted longer than their short relationship.

videos.title: Bitter Break-Up; Dissatisfied Tenants
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. In the first proceeding, after a friendship of 20 years, two women begin dating and move-in together; their relationship ends in a fight over a car, appliances and a trip to Cancun. In the next case, a married couple sue for damages after their landlord cuts down a tree on the landlord's property and allegedly damages their child's trampoline.

videos.title: Pit Bull on the Prowl
videos.overview: Neighbors fight over vet bills when a Chihuahua is mauled by a Pit Bull on their shared doorstep. The Pit Bull owner insists the attack never happened.

videos.title: Car Repo Breakdown
videos.overview: A woman claims she was only a day late on a payment when her ex-friend repossessed her vehicle; her friend accuses her of filing a false restraining order for harassment.

videos.title: Credit Score Kill
videos.overview: A man sues a mother and daughter for $7,500 allegedly owed on a car loan agreement; they countersue for harassment and emotional distress.

videos.title: Pet Adoption Fail; Texas Natural Disaster Repair
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a woman accuses the president of a Maltese rescue organization of lying about the pet she adopted. In the next case, a plumber is accused of price-gouging during a natural disaster in Texas that left thousands in need of home repairs. A woman claims she was bullied into paying triple the amount for his services.

videos.title: Unwed Parents Feud
videos.overview: Parents of an infant fight over money, visitation and an alleged assault.

videos.title: School District Desirability
videos.overview: A mother sues a California landlord for the 10K court max for allegedly reneging on a deal to rent an apartment to her.

videos.title: Pit Bull Puppy Attack
videos.overview: A 12-year-old boy recounts the story of the mauling of his puppy by an unleashed pit bull; the pit-bull owners are sued for the 10K max for vet bills and emotional distress.

videos.title: My Ex…Con Owes Me
videos.overview: An ex-con, trying to get his life back on track, is sued by an ex-girlfriend who claims he damaged her car and reneged on promises to pay back a personal loan.

videos.title: Life in a Condemned Warehouse
videos.overview: A woman claims her landlord refused to upgrade her living space in a condemned commercial property.

videos.title: Case of the Missing Yorkie; Boyfriend or Deposit
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. In the first case, after a puppy wanders off and goes missing for months, its owner receives a mysterious letter regarding the dog's alleged whereabouts. In the second case, a woman accuses her roommate of moving her boyfriend in without permission and refuses to return her security deposit.

videos.title: Vandalism Therapy
videos.overview: After quitting his job, a driver admits that he was aggravated with his boss and deliberately vandalized one of the vehicles in her fleet.

videos.title: Fool the Judge Once...
videos.overview: A man struggles to get his facts straight about the sale of a car when he sues his coworker's wife for payment of the vehicle.

videos.title: Dog Breeding Battle; Deceased Father's Estate Debate
videos.overview: In this episode, Her Honor presides over two cases. In the first, when an English Bulldog has puppies, cousins fight over pick of the litter, alleged breach of a breeding contract and defamation of character. In the next case, after the death of their father, siblings fight over $10K that was allegedly borrowed from his estate and never paid back.

videos.title: 35K Labor Dispute
videos.overview: A retired police officer sues a man for failure to pay for his advocacy services in a high-stakes labor dispute involving back wages and allegedly unfair work conditions.

videos.title: Minnesota Car Misha; Flipping Cars and Vandalism
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, when a used car breaks down only days after its purchase, the buyer threatens not to register the vehicle and to accrue hundreds in parking tickets in the seller's name. In the next case, a man buys a car for $600 and then offers to sell it to a friend for 3K; the friend refuses to pay a dime and claims the car was a gift.

videos.title: Rescue Dog Drama
videos.overview: A Marine Corps veteran fights with her stepmother over custody of an elderly, rescue dog.

videos.title: Dating with Children
videos.overview: Single parents battle over a failed birthday trip to Vegas, alleged theft and the dismantling of a trampoline.

videos.title: You Jumped On My Car!; Last Will and Testament Strife
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. In the first, an army vet accuses a car buyer of jumping on her vehicle in an argument over the title; she sues for the court max due to emotional distress. In the next proceeding, a married couple hire a woman to prepare their wills and end up being sued for 8K in damages after allegations of vulgarities and harassment.

videos.title: Restaurant Nightmare
videos.overview: A businessman takes a risk by opening a new eatery during the height of the pandemic; his venture ends with alleged theft and a contract dispute.

videos.title: Shared Driveway Destruction
videos.overview: A house flipper and his neighbor claim guns were allegedly drawn during a fight over repairs to their shared driveway.

videos.title: Dog-Watching Nightmare; Ex-Fiancée Fight
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge presides over two cases. In the first, a woman's two puppies are reported stolen while left in the care of a neighbor; she sues for the cost of the dogs and for emotional distress. In the second case, a man sues his ex-fiancé for the 10K court max over vehicle possession; she countersues for thousands she claims she invested in a wedding that never happened.

videos.title: Remains of a 15-Year Relationship
videos.overview: A woman is accused of 'preemptively' cleaning out a joint bank account she shared with her live-in boyfriend.

videos.title: From Puppy to Protective Order; Motorcycle Brothers' Payback
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a restraining order and vet bills come into play when custody of a Miniature Australian Shepard is disputed. Next up, brother sues brother over the remaining balance on a motorcycle.

videos.title: ATV Crash; Relationship Phone Slam
videos.overview: Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, a teenager suffers serious head injury after the brakes on his 4-wheeler allegedly give out. Collateral damage from the accident is disputed. In the next case, police are called to the scene when a trained boxer gets into a fight with her estranged girlfriend; they fight over damages as a result of the altercation.

videos.title: Puppy Injury
videos.overview: A puppy makes an appearance in court after suffering a broken paw due to alleged negligence. Roommates fight over who's to blame.

videos.title: Friendly Car Crashing; Friends No More
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman loans her vehicle to a friend to get to work; her friend ends up totaling the car in an accident. Next up, a 30-year friendship comes to an abrupt end when two women fight over a suspended license, the cost of a vehicle and an alleged loan.

videos.title: Tickets and Titles Between Friends; Star-Studded Keytar Crisis
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. First, a man is sued by a friend for the alleged balance owed on a car; he is questioned about an 'evading the police' text that the Judge discovers. Next up, a software engineer sues a friend over design costs for an array of lights to enhance a keytar; the engineer is countersued for harassment.

videos.title: Cat/Dog Fight Caught on Tape; Online Dating Gone Wrong
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a cat is mauled by a neighbor's leashed dogs after the cat allegedly startles the dogs while on a walk. In the next case, after meeting online, a man loans thousands of dollars to his new girlfriend. She claims he was moving too fast and all monies exchanged were gifts, not loans.

videos.title: Emotional Title War; Tenant/ Landlord Drama
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman accuses her ex-boyfriend of selling their car without her permission; they sue each other for emotional distress. In the next proceeding, a woman sues her landlord for the return of money taken under allegedly false pretenses.

videos.title: Dog Gone Wild
videos.overview: A man sues for the 10k court max after being attacked by an off-leash boxer who escaped its dog walker. A neighbor's security camera captures the incident.

videos.title: Pedestrians Struck by Car
videos.overview: An uninsured, unlicensed teenager takes her mother's car and strikes a married couple in the crosswalk. They sue for 10K in medical bills and pain and suffering.

videos.title: Jailhouse Affair and Stitchy Situation
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, a man accuses his ex-girlfriend of using his credit card to bail out her new lover and says she stole his emotional support cat. In the 2nd case, a woman says she cancelled her 35th birthday gala because her dress was not delivered in time; she sues the designer for the cost of the party she never had and for emotional distress.

videos.title: Drunk Driving Collision
videos.overview: College football-watching devolves into a costly car collision; former high school friends fight over who is to blame.

videos.title: Slander on the Movie Set?
videos.overview: An aspiring filmmaker sues a producer/director for unpaid work and defamation of character.

videos.title: Mother's Day Grief and Personal Trainer in the Hotseat
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, a woman passes away on Mother's Day leaving her grieving son scrambling to pay for funeral expenses. In the second case, a woman sues her trainer for a personal loan; he claims her lawsuit was premature.

videos.title: Fighting While High
videos.overview: Half sisters wield a broomstick and a knife in violent disputes against each other; both filed restraining orders and sue for damages.

videos.title: Grand Theft Lizard
videos.overview: Ex-business partners fight over their snake-breeding venture; retaliatory theft of a lizard is caught on tape.

videos.title: Sword-Wielding Tenant
videos.overview: A man sues his ex-landlord for a false arrest after a heated argument.

videos.title: Modern Love Mayhem and Frenchie Fiasco
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a young woman sues her ex-lover for damages over an alleged assault. In the next case, a man's foray into the dog-breeding business ends in a 5K lawsuit over a French Bulldog puppy he sold to his tenant.

videos.title: Photoshop Fiasco or Social Media Misfortune?
videos.overview: A woman sues a photographer for using photos from a bartered session to promote his business on social media.

videos.title: Truck Fight
videos.overview: A mechanic is accused of threatening a customer after a fight over truck repairs escalates.

videos.title: Checks and Balances and Roommate Fallout
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, after discovering 8K in 'forged' checks, a woman sends a series of angry texts which leads a man to file for a restraining order. In the next case, a woman is evicted days after moving in; she sues for return of rent and emotional distress.

videos.title: Pit Bull Kennel Fail
videos.overview: Twin sisters accuse a retiree of assault after their rental agreement to board dogs falls apart; the defendant claims they hit him in the head with a 2x4.

videos.title: Wedding Planner Problem
videos.overview: Newlyweds sue their wedding planner for the 10k court max alleging their wedding party was ejected from a wedding venue; the planner says they still owe her money.

videos.title: Sister vs. Brother
videos.overview: A struggling mother of three claims her brother and his girlfriend disposed of her possessions without her permission.

videos.title: Washed Up Friendship and Time to Pay the Toll
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a woman asks a friend to buy and install a washer/dryer in her home but refuses to pay him despite her continued use of the appliances. She claims the color wasn't right and that they were damaged. In the second case, when a woman purchases a used car from a friend, she leaves hundreds of toll charges in her wake.

videos.title: Phone a Friend
videos.overview: A farm worker must defend against his ex-boss's claims that he owes for a phone, rent and a personal loan.

videos.title: Brawl for Dogs
videos.overview: Ex-roommates fight over a violent assault involving a lockout and an emotional support dog; one man claims he blacked out after a chokehold, another says it was self defense.

videos.title: Family Woes
videos.overview: After providing a home for her grandchildren while her son was in prison, a woman's relationship with her family falls apart after he and his fiance move in.

videos.title: High Security Break-Up
videos.overview: A woman is granted a lifetime restraining order against an ex-boyfriend who sues her for thousands in personal belongings he says she never returned.

videos.title: Funeral Feud
videos.overview: Brothers clash over funeral expenses for their mother; accusations of defamation ensue.

videos.title: Don't Bully Me
videos.overview: An American Bully breeder sues a man for the remaining balance on a puppy purchased for his seven-year-old daughter.

videos.title: Minor Crash and Trade Me Back
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, an unlicensed, uninsured teenager driver fails to yield and crashes into a vehicle carrying a mother and her toddler; who is at fault? In the next case, two men sue each other for the court maximum after their car-trade agreement falls apart; the fate of a 1947 classic Chrysler Sedan hangs in the balance.

videos.title: Don't Go Fund Me
videos.overview: After an apartment fire made her homeless, a woman sues a former friend who offered her a place to stay, for a wrongful eviction and unwanted sexual advances while staying with him. He countersues for damages due to false accusations.

videos.title: Three's a Crowd
videos.overview: After a fight with his pregnant girlfriend, a man invites a female acquaintance to move in; they clash over a personal loan, car damages and assault.

videos.title: Rag Doll Dog and Hairy Situation
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, two Pit Bulls jump over a fence and maul a neighbor's small dog; the Judge speaks to the responsibility that comes with owning dangerous dog breeds. In the next case, a woman sues a hairstylist claiming money owed for improperly installing a wig and destroying it.

videos.title: Guns Between Friends
videos.overview: A firearms instructor seeks compensation for a valuable rifle he loaned to an ailing client; the defendant says he sold the weapon after the client passed away to satisfy a debt owed by the deceased.

videos.title: T-Shirt Throw Down
videos.overview: A fundraising effort via t-shirt sales goes awry when a woman is dissatisfied with sample shirts and asks for a refund from a small business owner; a heated incident and a 5k defamation countersuit follow soon after.

videos.title: Holiday Dog Attack
videos.overview: A dog attack on Christmas day divides neighbors who fight over which of their dogs was the aggressor and who is responsible for vet bills.

videos.title: Cross Country Rescue and Wedding Debt Denied
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a man drives 2,000 miles to come to the aid of his son and his son's teen fiancé, then is sued by the couple for alleged theft and unpaid wages. In the next case, a newlywed is sued by her sister-in-law for a trip and for wedding expenses.

videos.title: To Lease or Not to Lease
videos.overview: While away on vacation in Hawaii, a woman claims her roommate turned in a lease renewal without her permission; the roommate has another story.

videos.title: Family Divided
videos.overview: Both parties sue for the 10k court max when parents fight with their child over ownership of an 18-wheeler; the Judge throws out the countersuit after a heated exchange.

videos.title: Romantic Reunion Fail and Wolfdog
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a couple reunites after 30 years only to be torn apart over personal loans after an ex-girlfriend comes back into the picture. In the second case, both parties sue for the 10k court maximum when the cost of a Wolfdog and alleged loss of income are disputed.

videos.title: The Unseen Roommate
videos.overview: Relative strangers regret signing a lease together when one loses their job and the other decides not to move in.

videos.title: Wig Out in ATL
videos.overview: The owner of a wig business claims that a stylist has been making purchases in someone else's name.

videos.title: Sisters No More and The Fix Is In
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, after a failed attempt to live together and dueling 10K lawsuits, the only thing two sisters agree on is that their relationship is forever damaged. In the second case, a woman sues a close friend for damages to her car he allegedly caused by attempting to temporarily repair the vehicle for her.

videos.title: Tough Love Dad
videos.overview: After being evicted by her father, a teenager sues him for the return of property she says is worth thousands. He accuses her of smoking pot and of breaking promises to help out around the house.

videos.title: Roommate Hell
videos.overview: A man is evicted from his own apartment after a roommate files a restraining order against him; they fight over Covid relief, unpaid rent and alleged fraud.

videos.title: Side Hustle Fail and Truck-Astrophe
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a man says he is hired by a former high school teammate to make auto-parts deliveries. Their working relationship ends with a claim of unpaid wages. In the second case, a mother of three claims she gave her children's uncle $2700 to buy a truck that never arrived; he claims he delivered the truck to her front door.

videos.title: That's a Wrap! and Ex-Con/Author Seeks the Sentimental
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, a young man decides that his new luxury car needs a clear, protective wrap; his girlfriend provides money for the purchase. She is demanding payback. In the next case, after a lengthy incarceration, a man sues relatives for the return of treasured keepsakes from their family home.

videos.title: Water Damage Control
videos.overview: A woman claims a bathroom leak caused extensive water damage after a plumber made a house call; the owner of the plumbing company denies any wrongdoing.

videos.title: Chihuahua Fright
videos.overview: A chihuahua is mauled by a larger dog; neighbors fight over liability and vet bills.

videos.title: Music Video Conflict and Family Overstays Welcome
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. First, a singer/songwriter sues the owner of a video production company for the money paid for music videos; the producer accuses him of violating their contract. In the next case, a woman sues her brother and sister-in-law for thousands in back rent and for damage to her property; they counter with claims of harassment and invasion of privacy.

videos.title: Parking Spot Assault Caught on Tape
videos.overview: A security camera captures the moment a senior citizen is shoved to the ground by a neighbor in an ongoing feud over a public parking spot.

videos.title: Stop Scrolling!
videos.overview: A woman claims she made concerning discoveries on her boyfriend's phone while he was sleeping. Mutual restraining orders, police intervention and alleged emotional distress come into play soon after.

videos.title: Dueling Evictions and Baby Shoes Biz
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a married couple move into a friends' house with 3 kids and 4 dogs in tow and end up suing them over an eviction and alleged property damage. In the second case, a single mother, running a baby shoe business, says the owner of a children's clothing website agreed to buy her company. They argue over the terms of that sale.

videos.title: When Parked Cars Attack and Lane-Split Decision Collision
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first proceeding, a driver refuses to take responsibility for slamming into a parked car because he says the vehicle was parked illegally. Up next, a motorcyclist is flipped into the air when an uninsured driver fails to yield; each woman claims the other is to blame.

videos.title: Teen Tread Lightly
videos.overview: A man claims his landlord illegally entered his apartment and accused his teen son of 'walking too hard'; the police are called to their shared home multiple times to intervene.

videos.title: From Flip to Flop
videos.overview: After flipping a home for profit, a realtor sues the videographer she hired to document her successful renovation process. He says he never signed on for a year-long job.

videos.title: Trespassing Husband and Cat Lover Chaos
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a man sues his estranged wife's boyfriend for damages after being accused of domestic violence when all he was doing was entering his own home. In the next case, ex-roommates, with two cats each, wage emotional warfare over household chores; a heated exchange leaves a woman claiming she feared for her life.

videos.title: Graphic Email Revenge
videos.overview: After a bitter break-up, a woman claims her ex-boyfriend showed inappropriate videos of her to his friends and sent a graphic email to her boss. He says she stranded him at a party and trashed his phone

videos.title: Dash-Cam Collision and Drug Test Danger
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, dash-cam footage of a moped's dramatic collision with a moving car weighs heavily in the determination as to which driver is at fault. In the next case, a federal employee in recovery claims marijuana was being smoked by her fellow tenants. When she brings this to the attention of her landlord, she claims she was evicted

videos.title: Minors and Majors Slander (Part 1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, a young man accuses his former boss of selling alcohol to a minor and of vandalizing his car.

videos.title: Minors and Majors Slander (Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, an employer counters his ex-employees' lawsuit with a 10K claim against them for slander and for filing a false complaint.

videos.title: Roommate Crosses the Line and Podcast Me Out
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, an errant lap dance leads to a heated argument between roommates which escalates into an alleged dog attack and vandalized furniture. In the second case, after receiving a large settlement, a young man invests thousands in his longtime friend's podcast. A case of Covid and differing artistic opinions leave them fighting over equipment.

videos.title: Hijacked Harmony
videos.overview: A musician demands recognition and payment for his creative work on a song; he sues for the 10K court maximum for breach of contract.

videos.title: Business Review Bombshell
videos.overview: An electrical contractor sues for the 10K court maximum for negative online business reviews that he claims hurt his business; he is countersued for 10K for allegedly filing a frivoulous lawsuit.

videos.title: DUI Slam into House and Covid Cancel
videos.overview: The Judge presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman is trapped in her home with her terrified dog for hours after an impaired driver crashes through the wall. In the second case, when a destination wedding is cancelled due to COVID, a young woman uses refunded airline vouchers. The bride-to-be says she paid for them, and they should have been returned to her.

videos.title: Caught in a Blind Spot and Luxury Car Chew Toy
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a woman is accused of repeatedly backing into a teen's car in her own driveway; her daughter testifies against her. In the 2nd case, a man alleges that at the sight of two growling pit bulls on his front porch, he retreated to the safety of his new car. He says the dogs proceeded to bite and scratch his week-old, luxury vehicle.

videos.title: Pool Rules Fail
videos.overview: A tenant's violation of pool rules leads a property manager to take drastic action. The tenant then sues for an alleged assault, attorney fees and emotional distress.

videos.title: Brews and Bruise
videos.overview: After the bars close, drinking continues in a park but ends when a flying beer can causes thousands in dental damages to a partygoer. Former high school teammates fight over who is to blame.

videos.title: Dance No More and Three's a Crowd
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, the Judge shares memories of her own childhood dance experience while mediating a payment dispute between a dance studio owner and a single mother. In the second case, a woman says her roommate's boyfriend entered their shared apartment unannounced and with his own key. She claims the voicing of her safety concerns led to her eviction.

videos.title: Short-Term Job Trauma
videos.overview: A woman claims her former employer accused her of being a drug addict and withheld wages. Her employer countersues for defamation of character.

videos.title: Sisters Cry Neglect!
videos.overview: A failed attempt at living together leaves sisters in a bitter dispute over alleged child neglect, a mysterious call to CPS and police intervention after a lockout.

videos.title: Underage Rage and Pet Debt Relief
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a Father's Day standoff between a teenager and his girlfriends' stepsister ends with the violent smashing of a car mirror. In the second, a man admits that he was only present during the euthanization of a beloved pet because his ex-girlfriend said she would forgive a debt if he provided emotional support.

videos.title: Business Is Only Skin Deep
videos.overview: A spa owner sues a former employee for the 10k court maximum claiming that the aesthetician broke their non-compete agreement and started working well within the seven-mile radius of her business.

videos.title: Restrained Grandfather
videos.overview: Despite being slapped with a restraining order for threatening his ex son-in-law, a grandfather continues to seek payback from him. An eviction, marital debt and care for his grandchildren come into play.

videos.title: Unlicensed Teen Accident and Don't Pocket My Profit
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a high school teacher accuses a student of a hit-and-run; the teen's father is reprimanded for allowing his uninsured teen to drive without a license. In the second case, after a woman's business is shut down by the government due to Covid, ex-roommates accuse each other of taking advantage of the rental relief program.

videos.title: Powerless Landlord
videos.overview: A landlord's new property comes complete with previous tenants who sue him for child endangerment due to alleged lead poisoning. The landlord countersues when they stop paying rent.

videos.title: Pay to Play and Contract Controversy
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a hair-salon owner helps a friend pay for a luxury vehicle which he proceeds to crash; instead of paying her back, he then buys an expensive electric sports car. In the second case, A man accuses his ex-friend of repossessing his car without just cause and demands payback for the 5K he put into it.

videos.title: Bobcat Bitterness
videos.overview: An unlicensed contractor sues for damages after a married couple stops payment on a $4200 check for demolition work. They accuse him of property theft and dispute payment for a tractor rental.

videos.title: Kindness or Kidnapping?
videos.overview: A man accuses his sister of kidnapping his special-needs teenager who was, unbeknownst to him, in need of life-saving, emergency brain surgery. The sister is seeking reimbursement for costs associated with that surgery and return of her nephew’s property.

videos.title: Post-Funeral Property Fail and Not a Pleasure Doing Business
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, years after the death of their mother, sisters fight over the disbursement details of her personal belongings. A woman says she only wants one photo with her mother as a keepsake. In the second case, an independent contractor on disability sues an old friend for an unpaid loan and money allegedly stolen from their joint bank account.

videos.title: Mini Schnauzer vs. Pit Bull
videos.overview: Police body-cam footage captures a woman's admission and regret that her pit bull attacked a neighbor's miniature schnauzer. Her actions after the attack tell a different story when pictures surface that show her off-leash pit bull roaming the neighborhood.

videos.title: Look Out for That Cone!
videos.overview: An amateur pilot sues for the 10K court maximum when his plane is allegedly damaged by a certified flight instructor who hit an object on the runway. Damning video evidence comes into play.

videos.title: One-Wheel Whammy and All Bets Are Off
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a teenager on a one-wheel, electric skateboard plows into the side of a car, flies onto the hood and falls to the ground. Lucky to be alive, he now faces a motorist suing for vehicle damages. In the next case, a single father wins a $36,000 sports gambling payout and gives his ex-roommate 6K to 'hold' for him. She claims it was a gift.

videos.title: Sort of Married
videos.overview: Both parties seek the 10K court maximum when a man's death brings to light the fact that he was never married to his 'wife'. Family members and his estranged 'partner' fight over an allegedly false police report and personal property.

videos.title: World's Worst Intervention
videos.overview: A woman is lured into an ill-conceived 'intervention' at a friend's home by being told she will receive drugs once she gets there. She is sued for breaking a TV in a fit of rage, but countersues for damages caused by the emotional trauma she suffered.

videos.title: Dumbest Move for Unmarried Couples
videos.overview: Scrappy the French Bulldog makes an appearance in court when a woman sues her kickboxer exboyfriend for custody of their shared pet. The Judge admonishes them for making a long-term pet decision in a short-term relationship.

videos.title: Vengeful Plumber and Relationship Repair
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, when a plumber sues an employer for filing an allegedly false restraining order, the Judge must decide if an ominous voicemail was cause enough for the complaint. In the second case, long after a relationship ends, dueling text messages help the Judge decipher the facts about a disputed loan between ex-lovers.

videos.title: Vandalism and Cyberbullying (1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, a man fears for his safety and leaves his home when six men show up to defend his roommate during a heated argument. He returns the next day to find his room has been thoroughly vandalized.

videos.title: Vandalism and Cyberbullying (2)
videos.overview: In part two, a woman claims she was framed for vandalism and falsely arrested. She seeks compensation for slashed tires and alleged cyberbullying.

videos.title: Mothers, Fathers, Boyfriends Oh My!
videos.overview: When divorced parents sue each other for the 10k court maximum, a teenager is caught in the middle of a feud over a 'maliciously' towed vehicle and multiple reports to child services.

videos.title: Mean Girls and Wedding Planner vs. Newlywed
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a man with 4 children by 3 different women is at the center of a fight between two of the mothers. He remains silent while they fight over harassment, alleged gun-brandishing and vandalism. In the 2nd case, a bride only offers $50 to her planner who paid thousands to help make sure her California ranch wedding took place during the pandemic.

videos.title: Cat Fight
videos.overview: A fight breaks out between female veterinary workers and a passionate pet owner in seek of emergency care for his injured cat. He sues for damages after receiving a black eye in the parking lot.

videos.title: Deposit Disaster
videos.overview: A woman's demand that her 4K security deposit be returned is marred by the fact that she took the doorbell with her when she left.

videos.title: Skincare Snakedown (1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, a cosmetics salesman is accused of accosting and holding a woman captive for hours plying her with compliments and free samples.

videos.title: Skincare Snakedown (2)
videos.overview: In part two, the customer 'escapes' by purchasing an $8,000 rejuvenation wand and sues for fraud soon after.

videos.title: Grand Theft Child
videos.overview: After 'kidnapping' her own child from a family member and evading police, a woman is charged with child endangerment and spends four months in jail. She accuses her mother of stealing thousands from her while she was imprisoned.

videos.title: Festival Drug Business and Step-Father Car Fiasco
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman loans 10K to a new friend to support his supplement business; he claims it was an investment in a plan to sell 'happy pills' at festivals. Up next, a single mother with four children and good credit sues for 10k when her stepfather reneges on a car deal. She is left with payments for 2 vehicles and a dwindling credit score.

videos.title: Business Partners No More
videos.overview: Six years of peace and harmony between divorcees come to an abrupt halt when three ATVs and a $58,000 truck are at stake.

videos.title: Cheating Expulsion
videos.overview: When a young man is caught cheating three times, he is expelled from school. His steadfast father reverses charges for his son's tuition and is now faced with a lawsuit by administration for doing so.

videos.title: He Stole My Land!
videos.overview: When neighbors feud over property and attorney fees, the Judge shares her own personal story about a neighbor who refused to amicably resolve an easement issue.

videos.title: Costume Wars and Elder Abuse Accusation
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, an online influencer seeks the 10K court maximum from a tailor he claims botched the creation of his dream costume. The 'ill-fitting' ensemble is modelled in court by its disgruntled owner. Up next, a caregiver takes $400 from a 90-year-old dementia patient because 'she told me to.' After her patient suffers a fall, she is dismissed.

videos.title: Cash Not Cops
videos.overview: To avoid points on his driving record, a trucker offers cash to a fellow motorist after an accident. Their arrangement falls apart when repair estimate amounts and dates vary wildly.

videos.title: Baby Horse Rejection and Bad Bug Paint Job
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman makes a deposit on a foal six months before its birth but wants out of the contract once the animal is born. Believing the baby horse could not be insured, she sues for breach of contract. In the second case, a disabled veteran sues for a $6500 refund when the paint job on her beloved 1969 Volkswagen starts 'bubbling'.

videos.title: Beachside Community Fail
videos.overview: A man is sued for property damage to a $1400 a month pool house with no indoor plumbing. He claims his landlord assaulted him in a fight over unpaid utilities and disrespect.

videos.title: Go Fund Me Memorial Dispute and Passed Out Behind the Wheel
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, after a popular medical student tragically drowns, his friends raise over 40K in his honor. His mother and sister fight over his property and the funds collected. Next, a woman denies being under the influence of anything other than Benadryl when she slams into a parked car and pushes it 25 feet down a sidewalk. She is sued for damages.

videos.title: No Tub Left Behind
videos.overview: An ex-con's fresh start with his wife in a new home is marred by their landlords' lawsuit over property damage, unpaid rent and defamation. A missing claw-foot tub comes into play.

videos.title: Dude Where's My Truck? and Broken Bonds
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, a young man tries to do the right thing when he pays his great aunt $500 for an old truck she left on his property. She sues him for 5K after he disposes of the vehicle. Up next, a man is arrested when an argument with a friend escalates into a public altercation. ‘False' arrest claims are questioned when an active warrant comes to light.

videos.title: Mother and Son Fallout and Crypto Controversy
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a mother and son are no longer on speaking terms after a deal to purchase a van falls apart. He claims the inoperable van was a gift and that any discussion of money was only to appease her after the fact. In the next case, a mechanical engineer and a programmer fight over profits from their shared cryptocurrency mining business.

videos.title: Car Keying Caught on Tape
videos.overview: A not-so-neighborly dog walk results in vandalism and police intervention. A woman sues for a false arrest, lawyer fees and damages caused by the trauma of a night in jail.

videos.title: Meet the Truth! and Loan Shark Sticker Shock
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a man changes his story many times when asked to prove that monies loaned to him by an ex were never meant to be paid back. In the next case, following their break-up, a man loans the mother of his child 10K to escape the burden of 500-800% interest rates on her personal debt. They fight over payback when a new boyfriend comes into play.

videos.title: Mexican Pet-Napping Fiasco
videos.overview: Both parties seek the 10K court maximum when a real-estate purchase 10 miles south of the border goes awry. A new homeowner is accused of illegally evicting the previous owner and extorting her for money by holding her pets as ransom.

videos.title: Hit-and-Run House Slam and 'Kayak Conflict
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a victim of a hit-and-run makes the split-second decision to slam her car into a house instead of oncoming traffic. Her actions may have saved lives, but she is sued for property damage by a homeowner. Up next, an alcohol-fueled altercation over a cheating girlfriend leaves friends at odds over an alleged assault and two kayaks.

videos.title: Bouncy House vs. Large Dogs
videos.overview: Two large dogs set their sights on a 38-foot, inflatable, obstacle course and chew into a portion of the structure. Business partners seek compensation for damages to their party rental equipment.

videos.title: You Totaled my Car! and Gambling Girlfriends
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a 21-year-old drives her guardian's car without permission, crashes and totals the vehicle leaving family members to fight over damages. Up next, former gambling buddies fight over a jackpot win, missing jewelry and a little white lie to a boyfriend about where the grocery money went.

videos.title: Cash Clash and Sip n' See Dispute
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, both parties seek the 10K court maximum when old friends fight over an RV escalates into a physical assault. Up next, new parents hire an event planner to organize a Sip n' See celebration of their newborn child. The planner backs out when jealousy and threats surface; she is sued for a refund.

videos.title: Co-Parenting Strife
videos.overview: Bad blood between unwed parents leads to a fight over a three-year-old car accident and an attempt to collect far more than the car is worth. Jail time, alleged domestic violence and admitted drug use come into play.

videos.title: Farmin' Pigs Profit Margin
videos.overview: In a small Idaho farming community, a teenager sells four piglets to a neighbor and expects to be paid in full. The buyer claims all four animals died and that he owes nothing.

videos.title: Prison Pen Pal Trouble
videos.overview: An unlikely friendship develops between a male nurse and a female inmate through a prison pen pal program. Soon after her release, their once-supportive relationship devolves into a fight over stimulus checks and a car loan.

videos.title: What Not to Teach Your Teenager and Padding the Bill?
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, despite eye-witness testimony, a man insists that his unlicensed girlfriend was not driving his truck when it backed into a neighbor's house. His teenage son backs up his story. Next, a mechanic refuses to return a woman's wrecked car until he is paid; she admits to spending insurance money intended for car repairs on her own personal expenses.

videos.title: Generational Scam
videos.overview: A senior victim of bank fraud seeks restitution from her teenage, great granddaughter who made the mistake of accepting mysterious checks from an ex-con relative.

videos.title: Violence Between Foster Friends
videos.overview: Teenagers who met in foster care get into a catfight over a boy. Their fight escalates into an aggressive act of caught-on-tape vandalism, an arrest and a 10K lawsuit.

videos.title: Love Triangle Drama and Halloween Party Gone Wrong
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. First, a young woman breaks up with her live-in boyfriend and starts to date their new roommate. The ex-boyfriend sues the happy new couple for $10K and for the return of his two cats. Next, business partners pay $6K to rent a party space for teens; they sue for breach of contract when event restrictions are put in place without their approval.

videos.title: Caregiver Stayed But Not Paid
videos.overview: A man is sued for alleged failure to pay his late mother's caregiver. He accuses the healthcare worker of contributing to the 'delinquency of an elderly patient' by giving his dying mother cigarettes and marijuana.

videos.title: Car Thief Hit-and-Run
videos.overview: A 14-year-old girl steals her mother's car, goes on a joyride and T-bones an unsuspecting motorist on her way to work.

videos.title: Teen Party Flood Damage and Inheritance Damages
videos.overview: A teenager accidentally breaks a sprinkler and causes $9K in flooding throughout an apartment building; after inheriting her late brother's home, a woman triples the rent on his remaining tenant and sues him for alleged property damage.

videos.title: Daycare Dilemma
videos.overview: The Judge questions a young mother's decision to leave her babies in a potentially dangerous situation.

videos.title: Child Abuse Allegation Nightmare (Part 1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, a woman who suffered abuse as a child is convinced her neighbor is guilty of neglect and reports her to DCS multiple times.

videos.title: Child Abuse Allegation Nightmare (Part 2)
videos.overview: In part two, the Judge must decide if a woman's allegations are justified as feuding neighbors sue for the 10k court maximum over an alleged assault and shocking charges of child endangerment.

videos.title: Car Rental Mystery
videos.overview: Former army buddies pool their resources to purchase one luxury vehicle in order to start a car rental business; a doomed rental ends with the vehicle being wrecked, their insurance being dropped and thousands in damage.

videos.title: Widow Cries Thief!
videos.overview: A young widow with a newborn baby claims her deceased husband's best friend stole money from his account; the best friend defends his actions passionately and says the money went to a GoFundMe set up for his children.

videos.title: Puppy Problems
videos.overview: To make ends meet, young parents decide to sell their pets; they immediately regret their decision and fight for the return of one of their dogs.

videos.title: Hoop Nightmare
videos.overview: To compensate for lost playing time during Covid, a devoted father pays a basketball coach $8500 to start up a team for his son. He sues for damages when the team falls apart.

videos.title: Next Level Road Rage
videos.overview: A man claims he was falsely arrested after a road rage incident in which he was accused of wielding a gun. The victim of his alleged fury submits her frantic 911 call claiming a gunshot can be heard in the background.

videos.title: Small Business Grudge
videos.overview: A battle of bad online reviews is waged in rural Michigan between a pet daycare business and a water supply company.

videos.title: Divorcee Debate and Goldendoodle Mishap
videos.overview: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, divorcees fight over the fate of $10k in tools: he says she had no right to sell his deceased father's equipment; she says the mortgage had to be paid, and they only sold for $1K. Up next, "Dulce" the Goldendoodle puppy suffers a broken leg while in the care of a new dog sitter who is accused of leaving the pet alone with a child.

videos.title: Teen Caught in the Middle
videos.overview: Estranged parents fight over their teenager's cell phone, sporting events and a trip to Portugal.

videos.title: Pit Bull Ambush (1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, a woman does her boss a favor by dropping off lunch to her home only to be attacked by her pit bull the moment she steps through the doorway. The terrifying attack is caught on video.

videos.title: Pit Bull Ambush (2)
videos.overview: In part two, after a pit-bull attack, the dog's owner insists that the victim was given fair warning and told not to enter the home.

videos.title: Father and Son Scooter Collision
videos.overview: While riding a scooter together, a man and his son are hit by a truck and thrown to the ground; the father sues the driver for damages but soon finds himself in the hot seat over his handling of the scooter.

videos.title: Feuding Sisters
videos.overview: After a failed attempt at living together, sisters fight over property damage and the alleged theft of over $14k from their grandmother's inheritance.

videos.title: Baby Bird Fatality and Dedicated Grandmother: Deliquent Father
videos.overview: In this episode, the Judge rules on two cases. Up first, a German Shepherd digs under a fence, enters a neighbor's house and kills their baby Macaw. The dog’s owner says they should have had a stronger fence. In the next case, a woman faces an uphill battle trying to collect on a loan from her granddaughter's father. The Judge is appalled by how he treats the woman raising his 12-year-old child.

videos.title: Baseball Brawl
videos.overview: A youth baseball umpire sues for the $10K court maximum after being violently attacked by a coach whose team was disqualified for fielding illegal players. The umpire's son stepped in to defend his father, only to become the target of an attack by angry parents.

videos.title: Crash Caught on Camera and Fundraising Tragedy
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a woman sues a motorist for destroying her parked vehicle in a catastrophic five-car accident. Video reveals the harrowing collision, the near-death of a pedestrian and the car at fault. Next, after the tragic death of her daughter, a grandmother sues her ex daughter-in-law over money raised at a spaghetti fundraiser for her grandchildren.

videos.title: The Prison Connection
videos.overview: A 20-year-old with four young children seeks emotional distress compensation when an acquaintance of her incarcerated husband allegedly embarks on a campaign of harassment and defamation.

videos.title: Truckstop Video Vendetta
videos.overview: When a relationship ends, a woman seeks payback of money loaned to help her ex-boyfriend in his custody battle. He countersues, claiming she sent a doctored video to his workplace that got him fired and orchestrated a smear campaign that jeopardized his parental rights.

videos.title: The Love Bomb Loan and Beard Product Heist
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, after four weeks of dating, a woman is persuaded to invest $10K in a car-flipping venture. She fights to recover her investment when the relationship ends, and the business fails. Next, a man drives cross country to help an entrepreneur sell her beard-care products at a fair. Their collaboration ends in a battle over 78 jars of merchandise.

videos.title: A Keyed Affair
videos.overview: When jealousy sparks a heated argument between two women vying for the same man, a legal battle ensues, fueled by car vandalism and escalating threats.

videos.title: The Tenant's Revenge
videos.overview: A contentious landlord-tenant dispute escalates when two men file dueling restraining orders and sue each other over a security deposit, emotional distress, and harassment.

videos.title: Relationship Roadblock
videos.overview: A jointly-owned vehicle is at the center of the conflict between a man and his current and past girlfriend, both of whom share children with him. Missed payments, insurance lapses, and damages from an accident further complicate the dispute.

videos.title: Music Partnership Fiasco (1)
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, a disabled veteran turned music entrepreneur sues one of 'Atlanta’s top performers’ for the $10K court maximum.

videos.title: Music Partnership Fiasco (2)
videos.overview: In part two, a music entrepreneur alleges assault and defamation and considers her partnership with a dancer/singer from Atlanta as the biggest mistake of her life. Their doomed dog-breeding venture comes into play.

videos.title: Piglet Wars
videos.overview: A seasoned businesswoman and an animal lover dispute the sale of prized miniature pigs. When one piglet dies in transit, and another succumbs shortly after arrival, the absence of a signed contract complicates their legal battle.

videos.title: Bitter Bloodlines; Teen Burden and A Tail of Negligence
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, following an honorable discharge from the military, a teen seeks refuge with her aunt. Months later, she is labeled a ‘burden’ and decides to move out. She sues for belongings left behind. Next, a dog lover is devastated when she entrusts 5 dogs to her groomer but only 4 are returned to her. She is told the dog ‘escaped’ and sues for damages.

videos.title: Road Rage Rampage Caught on Tape
videos.overview: In a violent road rage incident, a terrified motorist accuses a driver of deliberately smashing his car window as he attempted to flee the scene after bumping the other car. The defendant claims self-defense, alleging the plaintiff struck him with his car and broke his hand. Both parties submit video footage of the confrontation.

videos.title: When Cane Corsos Attack
videos.overview: A man seeks $10K in damages for emotional distress after his neighbor's two Cane Corsos injure his German Shepherd. The neighbor claims that the plaintiff's dog started the fight and countersues for $10K, arguing that he was bitten while attempting to separate the dogs.

videos.title: Care Facility Showdown
videos.overview: A concerned aunt sues the owner of a group home for disabled adults after suspicions that her niece was tricked into shoplifting while living there. The landlord claims his son was held hostage by being blocked in the driveway during their move-out process.

videos.title: Bullet-Riddled Betrayal
videos.overview: During an outing to purchase illegal drugs, a teenager driving his girlfriend’s car is caught in gun crossfire. To evade shots fired, he swerves and crashes the vehicle. His girlfriend reports the car as stolen and seeks $7K in damages to her now bullet-ridden ride.

videos.title: Puppy Thief Mystery
videos.overview: After losing sight of her unleashed French Bulldog puppy, a woman accuses a neighbor of stealing the animal. Testimony from an animal control officer confirms that the neighbor had the dog on the day it disappeared and that the dog's whereabouts remain unknown.

videos.title: Money, Mischief, and a One-Eyed Cat and The Harley and the Frenchie
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a man accuses his ex-girlfriend of embezzling several thousand dollars. She claims he intentionally injured her cat, causing the beloved pet to lose an eye. Next, motorcycle enthusiasts accuse a man of stealing their antique Harley-Davidson and sue for $10K. The man claims he paid for the cycle in 'shatter' (a marijuana concentrate).

videos.title: Alleged Horse Abuse and Dog Rescue Gone Wrong
videos.overview: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode.
